metadata.scenario: A prospect contacts the support team to discuss a mysterious charge on their bill, suspecting an error. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Harold Gonzalez. I'm calling because I noticed a charge on my bill that I don't understand. I’m sorry to hear that, Harold. Can you tell me the charge you're referring to? Yes, it’s for $95 and it says “Skilled Nursing Care.” I wasn’t expecting that. I can help you with that. When was the service provided? It looks like it was just a week ago, but I thought my last visit was covered by my insurance. I understand, Harold. Let me check your account details to clarify. One moment, please. Sure, take your time. Thank you for your patience. I see that the charge was for a skilled nursing visit that included vital sign monitoring. But I thought that was included in my regular care plan. It usually is, but there may have been additional services performed during that visit. Can you tell me what those additional services were? Yes, it appears that the nurse also provided medication management during that visit. Ah, okay. I see. But I still want to confirm with my insurance about coverage. That's definitely a good idea. Would you like me to assist you in getting a detailed invoice for that visit? Yes, please. That would be very helpful. I can email that to you. What’s your preferred email address? It’s haroldgonzalez@email.com. Got it! I will send that invoice right away. Thank you. I really appreciate your help. You’re welcome, Harold. Is there anything else I can assist you with today? Actually, yes. I might be interested in scheduling some additional nursing visits. That’s great to hear! Would you like me to connect you with our Care Coordinator for more details? Yes, please. That would be perfect. Let me transfer you to Lisa Chen, our Care Coordinator. One moment, please. Thank you, Margaret! Thank you for your call, Harold. Transferring you now. (transfer sound) (to Lisa) Hi Lisa, I have Harold Gonzalez on the line. He has a billing question and is interested in additional nursing visits. (transfer sound)
